findings.problem: Shared 時鄧艾至成都 narrative (s0098–s0100) introduces the Wei conquest of Chengdu without regnal or Western dating in chapter text.
findings.action: Keep claims unresolved or pin AD 263 (or other) only with explicit souring beyond 時; separate judgments per actor (Du Zhen, administrator, Deng Ai, Qian Hong).

findings.problem: 及洛陽覆沒 on s0117 anchors Du Pi’s flight and Wang Dun’s Yi nomination without a stated year.
findings.action: Research Yongjia-era chronology externally or retain undated event records; do not certify identical Western intervals for Pi, Wang Dun, and Liu Chun from one undated clause.
